Samir Patel: quick follow-up on multi-region handoff: proposal = lightweight route leases from control-plane that proxy caches and adds as X-Route-Lease. primary goal: avoid split-writes when capacity shifts.
Leah Gomez: I like leases. key invariants? e.g., what if a lease expires mid-request?
Anna Chen: runtime invariant: verify lease at request start only. if it expires during processing, the request completes. we must document that guarantee.
Miguel Torres: proxy sync fetch on miss is too slow. plan: cache per-tenant TTL=30s, refresh at 70% TTL; sync fetch budget 25ms on cold miss.
Leah Gomez: need fencing to prevent concurrent writers. token should include epoch and be signed. runtimes reject older epoch -> 409 lease_conflict.
Samir Patel: agreed. control-plane issues {lease_id, epoch, expires_at, signed_token}. proxy sends X-Route-Lease: <signed_token>. data-plane validates signature and epoch vs last_seen. older -> 409 + hint refetch_lease.
Priya Rao: legal/security: signed token must not leak PII; redact tokens in logs. retention of lease events needs policy.
Miguel Torres: metrics: lease_fetch_latency_ms, lease_refresh_failures_total, write_fenced_conflicts_total. ops-bot: alert if refresh_failures spike.
Anna Chen: optional UX: tenant flag prefer_failover=true lets proxy auto-refetch and retry once on 409. default is surface 409 to client.
Leah Gomez: rollout: 1) proxy annotate with unsigned leases (no enforcement) 2) runtime accepts unsigned+signed (warning) 3) issue signed tokens + verifier 4) enable enforcement behind flag. document rollback.
Samir Patel: action items: Anna spec + migration steps; Miguel CI tests + dashboards; Leah runtime invariant doc; I'll prototype signer and key rotation handling.
ops-bot: task-created: ci/leases/parallel-fence tagged lease-fencing.
Anna Chen: will send draft spec by Tue EOD.
Leah Gomez: +1, will ensure 409 never causes partial durable writes.
